name: Harmonic Picks
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Picks from your whole USB library that fit the playing deck by key and BPM; press one to load it.
description:
Test build 0.2.1, not yet run on a deck. Mod Menu > Harmonic picks. Searches your whole rekordbox library on both USBs, not one playlist: up to 40 tracks in the same, a neighbour or the relative key of the deck that started last, within the BPM range (3, 6 or 10%; half and double time count). Green = same key, VOX = acapella.

Knob: move. Press a pick: it is found in a playlist it is in and loaded on a stopped deck (the pair's other deck first, never a playing deck). Touching any control stops it. "Press loads a pick" off = only highlight it.
